body:
We're using the -M flag as covered [here](https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/2063), but out build process also involves running DXC with the -P flag to preprocess the file.

It'd be great if the -MD and -MF flags were supported when running DXC in -P preprocess only mode.
title: Support -M depfile generation flags during -P preprocess to file
